description: A JavaScript plugin extending Date object functionalities for date manipulation, parsing, and formatting. The code defines various methods for navigating dates, parsing date strings, and handling cultural differences in date representations.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Sets the date to the next occurrence based on internal orientation setting.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Sets the date to the previous occurrence based on internal orientation setting.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Marks the date object as being in 'is' mode.

methods.name: same
methods.description: Marks the date object as representing the same date for comparison purposes.

methods.name: today
methods.description: Resets the date object to today's date and marks it as 'same'.

methods.name: weekday
methods.description: Determines if the date is a weekday based on internal flags.

methods.name: at
methods.description: Sets the time of the date object based on a string or a date.
